purpose: Inform the user's decision using auditable facts, favorable factors, risks and unknowns
policy_type: Project specification; not a runtime feature flag
reported_operator_capacity: May quote original dated and scoped publication; no inference of project-specific availability
planned_reinforcements: Potentially favorable only with relevant scope and explicit planned status; no assumed extra MW
connected_projects_and_pipeline: Potential competition only with evidenced shared infrastructure and relevant direction; no automatic negative effect from count or proximity
data_quality: Separate descriptive assessment of authority, recency, coverage and conflicts
